info.name: Jadwa Fund Management System - Sprint 2 Complete API Collection
info.description:
Comprehensive API testing collection for Jadwa Fund Management System covering all Sprint 2 implementations including Alternative 1 & 2 workflows, complete Resolution management, Board Member management, and all 17 alternative scenarios.

**SPRINT 2 COMPLETE IMPLEMENTATION (98% Complete - 121/123 Story Points):**

**RESOLUTION MANAGEMENT ENDPOINTS:**
- GET /api/Resolutions/ResolutionsList - List resolutions with role-based filtering
- GET /api/Resolutions/GetResolutionById - View resolution details by role
- POST /api/Resolutions/AddResolution - Create resolution (supports Alternative 2 workflow)
- PUT /api/Resolutions/EditResolution - Edit resolution (supports Alternative 1 & 2 workflows)
- DELETE /api/Resolutions/DeleteResolution - Delete draft resolutions
- PATCH /api/Resolutions/CancelResolution/{id} - Cancel pending resolutions
- PATCH /api/Resolutions/ConfirmResolution/{id} - Confirm resolutions (Fund Manager)
- PATCH /api/Resolutions/RejectResolution/{id} - Reject resolutions with reason
- PATCH /api/Resolutions/SendToVote/{id} - Send confirmed resolutions to vote

**BOARD MEMBER MANAGEMENT ENDPOINTS:**
- POST /api/BoardMembers/AddBoardMember - Add board members with business rules
- GET /api/BoardMembers/GetBoardMembers - View fund board members

**ALTERNATIVE WORKFLOWS SUPPORTED:**
- Alternative 1: Voting suspension for VotingInProgress resolutions (MSG006/MSG007)
- Alternative 2: New resolution creation from Approved/NotApproved (MSG008/MSG009)
- All 17 alternative scenarios from Sprint.md specifications

**REQUIRED ENVIRONMENT VARIABLES:**
- base_url: API base URL (e.g., https://localhost:7001)
- fm_access_token: Fund Manager JWT token
- lc_access_token: Legal Council JWT token
- bs_access_token: Board Secretary JWT token
- bm_access_token: Board Member JWT token
- created_fund_id: ID of created fund for testing
- pending_resolution_id: ID of resolution in pending status
- confirmed_resolution_id: ID of confirmed resolution
- rejected_resolution_id: ID of rejected resolution
- voting_resolution_id: ID of resolution in voting status
- approved_resolution_id: ID of approved resolution for Alternative 2 testing
- original_resolution_id: ID of original resolution for Alternative 2 workflow
